facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold for the week, doing anything as long as he gets to kill people with the wasp; he would give back 5 gold for each killing he is allowed, provided he can do what he wants with the victims. Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.

classification.support_basis: Play establishes no want or debt of the party that a hired killer would advance; Ned's interest is killing people, not any established party goal.
classification.action_basis: Ned did offer his services on stated terms, but no concrete advantage toward a party want or debt is established.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold to hire him. Benefit: a killer with a wasp at the party's disposal, but no specific advantage toward an established want or debt is linked in play.
